decision: GO with restricted client-side batch editing for SAFE_COMMON fields only.
selection: Local Inventory IDs from the active working set; minimum two; not Network membership.
mixedValues: Show Mixed across selected Cells and keep the replacement input blank; never choose the first Cell's value implicitly.
review: User enables fields, enters values, reviews an explicit preview, then applies.
validation: Existing RF profile validation runs for every selected Cell. Invalid/missing Cell aborts the whole batch before state mutation.
mutation: Apply supported patch to all selected towers atomically; mark dataset-sourced Cells as project overrides; refresh selectedTower object by identity if it was edited.
freshness: One invalidatePlanResults call after successful apply; no automatic RF task.
draftAndVersion: Uses existing App-owned tower/project draft flow; no new persistence schema or auto-save. Save Version remains explicit under existing Scenario behavior.
evidence: Inventory multi-edit previews and applies only an enabled safe field; pure utility tests cover atomic validation and field allowlisting.
